Improving Ways of Working

How can I help build capability in my team?

Short Answer

Discuss the team's needs, share practical learning opportunities and support colleagues to apply new skills in their day-to-day work.

Detailed Guidance

Ask colleagues what they need to do more confidently and identify practical learning that fits their roles. Make time to share knowledge, practise new skills on real tasks and reflect on what is working, while recognising different experience levels and accessibility needs.
